items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: Johnny Hodges are two of the musicians I could listen to until it’s time to go

ctx.x: Did you have an era, returning to Ellington for a moment, the favorite Ellington band for you?

Oh absolutely. I’m like everybody else I guess that was Ellington fans at the time, although I was much younger and I didn’t appreciate it in the ‘41, ‘42 era, but Ben Webster and Johnny Hodges are two of the musicians I could listen to until it’s time to go, and when I go I want to take them with me. And so that sound of the Webster-Hodges connection in the ‘41, particularly the ‘41 band, is just a sound that as far as I’m concerned, nobody has ever been able to repeat. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Did you have a chance to see them live a number of times?
